'''Caseille Raskovni''' is a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Queen's Guards]].

== Appearance ==
She is lean with bells in her hair. She stands 5'6 tall, with a narrow face, dark eyes, and dark hair cut off above the shoulders and tied back with a black ribbon. 

She had mannish mannerisms, a brisk way of talking, and seemed tightly coiled. She seemed lean and hard as any [[Maiden of the Spear]].

She did not sound cultured or educated, but she was brisk and no-nonsense.

==History==
She is from [[Arafel]]. She was a merchant's guard for nearly twenty years, which was very rare.

She is reticent about her past.

== Activities ==
She is one of the Queens's Guards placed as a bodyguard when [[Elayne Trakand]] moves through [[Caemlyn]] to greet the people.
She comes to argue with Elayne about having a group of bodyguard around her when she goes to meet with the [[Borderlander]] Rulers. [[Birgitte Silverbow]] sends her away without any luck.

She is part of Elayne's bodyguard, when Elayne does her tour around [[Andor]] visiting all the minor Houses.

She leads the Bodyguards in the rescue attempt of Elayne from the [[Black Ajah]]. She escorts Elayne to her meeting with the neutral [[High Seat]]s.

Birgitte thinks she is a natural bannerman, but Elayne wants her to command, saying that a bannerman could handle about twenty (the number she hoped to keep the bodyguard to). 

She starts as an under-lieutenant, then becomes second to [[Doilin Mellar]] when he is Captain. She later becomes a lieutanent with two knots of rank.
